flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: What if you could join a rapidly growing company and play a critical role in bringing new medicines to patients through looking at and treating disease in a revolutionary way. What this position is all about : Are you a highly motivated and detail-oriented computational biologist passionate about understanding complex biological systems and disease through single-cell omics and large-scale patient datasets ? This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development and application of Cellarity’s platform. Specifically, you will identify disease-associated states from cell atlases and use our single-cell AI models to predict chemical entities that revert these states to healthy. You will be part of a dynamic and innovative computational team focused on generating high-impact insights. Collaborating closely with world-class computational biologists, machine learning scientists, experimental biologists, chemists, clinicians , and technologists , you’ll help co-develop hypotheses, build proprietary data assets, and advance exploratory drug programs. If you’re excited about applying your skills to real-world therapeutic challenges, working with proprietary, high-quality datasets, and learning from leading experts across disciplines, we want to hear from you. What you would be responsible for: Apply computational biology and machine learning tools to generate insights and hypotheses from high-dimensional molecular datasets, with a focus on large-scale scRNA-seq & snRNA-seq disease atlases. Develop & lead data analysis strategies and ideation across diverse biological and clinically relevant projects with internal and external stakeholders. Act as the computational biology co-lead on drug programs, working with experimental scientists to ensure that study designs & data are properly interrogated to deliver high value readouts. What experiences will you need: Ph.D. or equivalent in biology, computational biology, or related scientific field. 2+ years of relevant experience post Ph.D. Extensive experience in analyzing and deriving hypothesis from single-cell transcriptomic data, preferably also with large-scale single-cell atlases. Demonstrated scientific understanding of molecular and systems biology, diverse molecular data types, and analysis tools. Practical programming and scripting skills, preferably in Python. Fast learner, analytical thinker, creative, "hands-on", strong communication skills. Able to work both independently and as part of a team. What sets you apart: Background in metabolic or liver diseases, autoimmune disease, or hematology. Experience with generating, analyzing, and deriving hypotheses from other single-cell omics data types or large-scale clinical datasets. Experience driving an impactful and relevant project within industry. Background in statistics or machine learning. Experience with clinical or biological data. Interested in learning any of the above. What it’s like to work at Cellarity At Cellarity, we Push Boundaries: We create a legacy with breakthrough science in service of patients. By shifting the focus from a single target to the underlying cellular dysfunction, we unravel the complexity of disease biology and create medicines that were never before possible. jobgether-jobgether:lever:02e7f06e-f2b9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data and AI Specialist based in the Canada . This is a high-impact role within a strategy and operations environment, focused on using data, automation, and AI to solve complex business challenges. You will develop intelligent workflows and analytical solutions that improve product quality, reduce fraud, minimize billing errors, and optimize network economics. The role combines hands-on technical execution with strategic problem-solving across complex telecommunications datasets. You will work closely with teams across carrier relations, engineering, product, supply operations, and finance to turn business needs into scalable data products. From SQL analysis and dashboards to Python automation and agentic AI workflows, you will modernize how teams investigate problems and access insights. The position offers significant ownership, allowing you to take projects from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, deployment, and measurable impact. It is an ideal opportunity for a data and AI specialist who enjoys moving quickly, experimenting with emerging technology, and solving meaningful problems at scale. Architect, test, and deploy LLM-powered agents and AI workflows that automate complex, multi-step, and previously manual data investigations. Build Python-based automation, APIs, and workflow solutions that transform repetitive processes into scalable, reliable operational capabilities. Develop both individual productivity tools and multi-user workflows that improve human efficiency and enable business teams to self-serve insights. Establish strong data architecture and AI orchestration practices focused on safety, accuracy, efficiency, maintainability, and reliable outputs. Perform advanced SQL analysis and root-cause investigations across complex telecommunications datasets to identify opportunities to improve network quality, reduce fraud, minimize billing errors, and optimize gross margins. Create dashboards and repeatable business intelligence solutions using tools such as Tableau, Looker, Python, Google Sheets, or Excel. Define meaningful KPIs and develop mechanisms to monitor performance, trends, and business outcomes over time. Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business problems into clear data requirements, governance standards, pipelines, and scalable data products. Communicate analytical findings clearly through written recommendations and verbal presentations that directly address business questions. Take end-to-end ownership of data products, from scoping and requirements gathering through documentation, development, execution, delivery, and ongoing improvement. Identify opportunities to replace manual analytics processes with innovative, agentic workflows and rapidly prototype solutions for future operational needs. Manage multiple priorities and ensure projects are delivered on schedule, to a high standard, and with measurable business and customer impact. Requirements 5+ years of professional experience developing technical data, analytics, automation, or related solutions. Extensive experience with SQL, relational databases, and complex data schemas. Strong proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel and experience with business intelligence platforms such as Tableau and/or Looker. Hands-on experience using Python, APIs, or workflow automation platforms such as Airtable, Coefficient, Zapier, or n8n to create automated data workflows and process pipelines. Experience building AI agents and applying LLM technologies to complex, multi-step, and unstructured problems, including familiarity with platforms or tools such as Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or comparable technologies. Strong understanding of data management, governance, quality, hygiene, and responsible use of technology. Ability to break ambiguous business problems into structured, manageable components

southparkcommons-rox-ai:ashbyhq:bd74dfe7.description: ABOUT ROX Rox is building the AI-native revenue operating system for modern go-to-market teams. Backed by Sequoia, GV, and General Catalyst, we’re working with some of the most ambitious enterprise teams to replace fragmented CRM workflows with intelligent, autonomous systems. Rox connects data across the GTM stack, deploys AI agents to do real work, and gives revenue leaders a clear, shared picture of what actually drives outcomes. We’re a small, fast-moving Series A team taking on one of software’s most entrenched categories — and we’re winning by combining deep technical rigor with obsessive focus on usefulness. ABOUT THE ENGINEERING TEAM Engineering at Rox is product-first and execution-driven. We build real systems used daily by revenue teams operating at scale, which means every architectural decision — frontend, middle-tier, or backend — has direct customer impact. Product Engineers at Rox are not siloed. While roles have clear areas of strength, engineers are expected to understand how the entire system fits together: how UI state maps to APIs, how frontend decisions affect backend load, and how product experiences scale as customers grow. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a Product Engineer role for someone who is truly expert in React and deeply opinionated about frontend quality, architecture, and user experience. You will own large portions of the product surface area — building complex React interfaces, shaping frontend architecture, and implementing the middle-tier logic that connects UI experiences to backend systems.
